WEGOVY PILL NOW AVAILABLE · CLINICIAN-LED CARE
Mounjaro vs Wegovy: which treatment could be right for you?
Reviewed by Dr. Juraj Galan
Back to journal
Quick answer
Mounjaro and Wegovy are once-weekly prescription injections used alongside nutrition, movement and behavioural support. Mounjaro contains tirzepatide and acts on GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Wegovy contains semaglutide and acts on GLP-1 receptors. Both can support significant weight loss, but suitability depends on your health history, goals, side-effect risk and availability.
Mounjaro vs Wegovy at a glance
Mounjaro
Wegovy
Active ingredient
Tirzepatide
Semaglutide
Manufacturer
Eli Lilly
Novo Nordisk
How often
Once weekly
Once weekly
Main action
GIP + GLP-1
GLP-1
Maximum study result
Up to 22.5%
Up to 14.9%
How the treatments work
Both medicines mimic gut hormones involved in appetite and blood-sugar regulation. They can help you feel fuller for longer and reduce food noise. Tirzepatide targets two receptors, while semaglutide targets one. This difference may affect average results, but it does not automatically make one option right for every person.
Expected weight-loss results
In clinical trials, adults taking the highest approved doses alongside lifestyle support lost meaningful weight over roughly 68 to 72 weeks. Average results vary widely, and percentages from separate studies should not be treated as a direct head-to-head comparison. Your response will depend on dose, adherence, health conditions and ongoing support.
Side effects and safety
The most common effects are gastrointestinal and may be strongest while increasing the dose. A prescriber should review your medical history, current medicines and any pregnancy plans before recommending treatment.
Nausea, diarrhoea or constipation
Vomiting, reflux or stomach discomfort
Reduced appetite and fatigue
Rare but serious risks require urgent medical advice
Who makes Mounjaro and Wegovy?
Eli Lilly
MAKER OF MOUNJARO
A US pharmaceutical company that developed tirzepatide and has researched incretin medicines for diabetes and obesity.
Novo Nordisk
MAKER OF WEGOVY
A Danish healthcare company with decades of research in diabetes and obesity, and the developer of semaglutide.
Frequently asked questions
Is Mounjaro stronger than Wegovy?
Can you switch between the treatments?
How quickly do results appear?
Are the medicines available without a prescription?
Sources and medical review
Key sources include the SURMOUNT-1 and STEP 1 clinical trials, European Medicines Agency product information, and prescribing information from Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk. This article is educational and does not replace individual medical advice.
Clinically reviewed for accuracy
Reviewed by Dr. Juraj Galan · Next review due August 2026
